author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬೆಳೆಯಿಸಲೆ ಗಮನಕೊಡು ನಿನ್ನ ಸಹಚಾರಿಗಳ
ಅಳುಕಿರದೆ ಅನುಮಾನ ತೆಗೆನಿನ್ನ ಮನದಿ
ತಳೆಯೆನೀ ನಿಷ್ಪಕ್ಷ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ಉದ್ಭವಿಸೆ
ಗಳಿಸುವೆಯೊ ಮನ್ನಣೆಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Pay attention to helping your companions grow;
clear the doubts from your mind without hesitation;
if you stay impartial when mistakes arise,
you will earn respect, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Help those who walk with you to grow, be free of suspicion, and stay fair when things go wrong. That is how respect is earned.
